read_file_contents: read the contents of a file and return it as a string or None on error
read_file_with_error_suppression: read a file silently without printing errors by setting print_error to False
read_file_with_debug: read a file with debug mode enabled to see start and end token indices
summarize_ReadFile: summarize the ReadFile function that opens a file and returns its contents or None on IOError
review_ReadFile: review the ReadFile function and its error handling for IOError exceptions
